div.ab: Concerning the law of the Mercians

ab.hi: On the Law of the Mercians

div.note: Liebermann prints D (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 201, p. 102, after Norðleod, c. 1060; by its author or someone using or influenced by him), O (Cambridge, Corpus Christi College 190, p. 418, another hand c. 1075, after the Confessional and Penitential of Egbert) and H (Textus Roffensis f. 39v, after Að, c. 1120, without heading, on a new line), with Ld, the Quadripartitus and the Instituta Cnuti III 42–43.4. K is H, which has no heading, so K is empty here; D is also given here. D's heading is in red; the Quadripartitus heading is not original. Liebermann dates Mirce c. 920–c. 970. Clause number standardised from ‘Mirce Inscr.’.; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (was “1002–23 (Whitelock); 1006–8 (Rabin)”, now “c.920–c.970 (Liebermann); 1002–23 (Whitelock); 1006–8 (Rabin)”)
Be Mircna laga: omitted H, text supplied from D
